from pathlib import Path
import json
base=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
tid='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
req=base/'requests'/f'{tid}.json'
res=base/'model_results'/f'{tid}.json'
runs=base/'models'/'runs'
matches=sorted(runs.glob(tid+'-*'), key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime) if runs.exists() else []
parts=[f'REQUEST={int(req.exists())}',f'RESULT={int(res.exists())}',f'RUNS={len(matches)}']
if matches:
    p=matches[-1]
    parts.append('CHECKPOINT='+p.name)
    for name in ['COMPLETE.json','WORKER.json','events.jsonl']:
        parts.append(name.upper().replace('.','_')+'='+str(int((p/name).exists())))
state=base/'models'/'STATE.json'
if state.exists():
    try:
        s=json.loads(state.read_text())
        parts += ['STATE='+str(s.get('state','')),'TASK='+str(s.get('task_id','')),'REASON='+str(s.get('reason','')),'RETRY_AT='+str(s.get('retry_at',''))]
    except Exception as e: parts.append('STATE_PARSE='+type(e).__name__)
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P3_ASTRA_STATUS')
print('ERROR='+'|'.join(parts))
raise SystemExit(1)
